<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 199.0, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral molecular mass of approximately 198 Da. A plausible organic formula with this exact mass is C₉H₁₀O₅, which matches the observed monoisotopic mass within typical experimental tolerance.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H10O5</final_answer>
